poster.hook: Ex-captain of the Pell House guard seeks her good name and eight years of pension.

story.appearance: Squat and square, with iron-grey braids pinned flat and a nose broken twice in the line of duty. She wears a rented evening coat over her chain shirt and tells everyone it is a fashion statement.
story.concept: For eight years Dagny kept the doors of Pell House, which meant stopping creditors, suitors and the occasional escaped mimic. Three months ago a letter in her own hand 'proved' she had been selling access to the vault, and she was dismissed without pension or reference. Corvin Pell died a few weeks later. She has not forgiven him, which is awkward, because he is dead.
story.stake: The letter that ruined her, and the pension bond he voided, are what he took from her. Her invitation says both are in Lot Thirteen. Without them she is a disgraced soldier with no pay and no prospects.
story.goal: Get the original forged letter into the hands of the Watch and her pension bond back into her own.
story.secret: Since the funeral, 20 gp has arrived on the first of every month in an unmarked envelope sealed with a wax magpie. She has told no one, because the money is the only thing keeping her in a room, and because she is almost certain a dead man doesn't post letters.
story.voice: Flat, unhurried, dry as chalk. Speaks in short sentences and orders. Calls everyone 'sir' or 'ma'am', whatever they are.
mannerisms: Counts the doors and windows when she enters a room
Keeps her shield-arm turned to the nearest stranger
Straightens a gorget that is no longer there
story.trinket: Her captain's gorget with the badge pried off

ties.text: The apprentice who worked through the nights. Dagny brought her soup and knew the girl was being used. She would stand between Odalys and any trouble.
ties.public: Brings the girl soup; thinks she works too hard

ties.text: She carried the coffin with five other guards. She said it felt too light. Anselm told her to sing the hymn and she did, and has regretted it since.
ties.public: Carried the same coffin as he blessed it

ties.text: Caught Nettle casing the east wall a week ago. Let them go with a warning, and found her own lockpick missing afterward.
ties.public: Threw them off the east wall once; mutual respect

story.intro: "Dagny Brask. Eight years I kept this door. Tonight I'm a guest, so hold your own coat."

features.name: Dwarven Resilience
features.text: Advantage on saves against poison, and resistance to poison damage.

features.name: Stonecunning
features.text: On History checks about the origin of stonework, you count as proficient and add double your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Dwarven Combat Training
features.text: You are proficient with the battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer and warhammer.

features.name: Action Surge
features.text: Take one additional action on your turn.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.text: You have 4 d8 superiority dice (save DC 13) and know three maneuvers: Parry (reaction; reduce damage by die + Dex), Riposte (reaction when a foe misses you; counter-attack and add the die to damage) and Goading Attack (add the die to damage; Wis save or the foe has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you).

features.name: Student of War
features.text: Proficiency with one set of artisan's tools (Cook's Utensils).

features.name: Military Rank
features.text: Soldiers and guards of your old rank still defer to you, and you can requisition simple gear or passage for yourself and companions.

equipment.name: Chain Mail
equipment.note: Hidden under a rented evening coat

equipment.name: Shield
equipment.note: Painted with the Pell House crest, which she hasn't sanded off
